headline: Delhi overtakes Lahore as world's most polluted major city as air quality deteriorates
description: <p>India’s capital, Delhi, overtook Lahore to become the world’s most polluted city on Friday, with air quality reaching hazardous levels and visibility dropping as smog blanketed the city of 20 million people.</p> <p>Earlier, Delhi’s air quality index (AQI) stood at 334, categorised as “hazardous”, making it the most polluted major city globally, according to Swiss air quality monitoring group <a rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank" class="link--external" href="https://www.iqair.com/world-air-quality-ranking">IQAir</a>, which measures pollution levels based

headline: Microsoft says 'not aware of any malicious activity' causing Outlook outage
description: <p>Microsoft said that it was not aware of any “malicious activity” behind the hours-long disruption of its Outlook services.</p> <p>“As of now, we are not aware of any malicious activity that is causing this incident. We will continue to treat this incident with urgency and priority until full resolution,” Microsoft said.</p> <p>Microsoft services such as Outlook and Teams were disrupted for about 10 hours on Friday as the tech giant struggled to fix issues with some servers, hitting businesses and government agencies globally that use the popular platforms.</

headline: Police ban private jirgas in Peshawar
description: <p>• Wedding halls, hotels warned against hosting such gatherings<br>• CCPO cites gun culture, clashes and hefty charges as reasons behind instructions</p> <p>PESHAWAR: Police have imposed a ban on private jirgas (informal dispute-resolution gatherings) and warned wedding halls and other venues against allowing such meetings on their premises, cautioning that violations would invite legal action.</p> <p>According to senior police officials, the decision was taken following a number of complaints and several incidents reported during private jirgas.</p>
